correctness.rationale: Cauchy facet brightness formula reduces exactly to Z_d=E_ε|Σ ε_i U_i|. Radial Gaussian decomposition yields exact gamma mean and bivariate normal absolute-product kernel; sign-pair Hamming overlap binomially enumerates the exact second moment. Taylor expansion through ρ^6 and gamma ratio through d^-3 cancels lower variance powers and gives Var(Z_d)=1/(3πd³)+O(d^-4). Spherical fourth-moment conditioning gives coefficient β_d and exact Var(H_d)=24(d−1)/((d+2)^2(d+4)(d+6)), leaving L² remainder O(d^-4). Gaussian representation U=G/||G|| and multivariate CLT/delta method give d^{3/2}H_d→N(0,24) and hence the stated N(0,1/(3π)). Independently numerically checked moment and harmonic residual at multiple dimensions; finite numerics not a CLT proof.
